text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking with Agnes Digital and 
discussing her next race... we passed by 
two Umamusume who seemed quite close.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! If you cling to me that tightly, 
it's kind of hard to walk~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Just now, I felt... a wave of emo-ness... 
W-Was it just my imagination...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! Sorry to interrupt out of 
nowhere... So, what were we talking 
about...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For her to miss out on 'emo vibes'... She 
must be completely exhausted. Maybe I 
should reconsider her race schedule.
